lines.text: Am I going to lose my agency?
Because now AI agents come into the picture.
They'll be able to do everything.
At least in US, there is a lot of stigma around AI.
I'm talking about the general population.
I'm not talking about the small data science community itself.
The fear around AI is stemming from
people who are entering the workforce, or even those who are working in the companies,
who are afraid around, you know, what is going to happen to us.
My point of view there, I don't think humans will be out of the loop.
But the role of the humans is going to change,
where they will have to look at AI outputs,
give corrective feedback,
keep improving AI algorithms.
You could also think of humans as a sense organ for AI,
to know what is happening in the real world.
Some events have happened,
certain disruptions have happened,
certain things that have happened that are not modeled into AI,
which is where the human context comes in,
where human provides the context that, hey, you know,
this recommendation that you gave was not useful for me
because of these, these, these reasons.
So human needs to be in place to catch those corner cases
and make sure that AI works really well.
In terms of job loss happening,
the way I look at is that for any companies that are scaling,
your business objective is scaling.
AI helps scale really well.
People's role itself is shifting from what they need to do day to day,
to making sure that AI is doing those things day to day,
and then they get a little bit more into the strategic role.
If we look at the world of analytics,
what was not possible before is
business stakeholders getting insightful reports
purely by giving a natural language instruction,
like they tell some analyst or an intern,
not even a senior manager.
Why are certain marketing campaigns not working?
Why revenue is dropping in, let's say, a certain region?
What can we do about it?
There was no application, not a system or a solution in place,
which can automatically answer these questions in an insightful way,
and even take action on that.
Now it is possible.
